speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with aggressive behavior, altered mental status, and autonomic dysregulation. To begin our assessment, are you currently taking any medications, and have you recently experienced a change in your sleep pattern?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient's roommates report that he has been displaying increasingly aggressive and unusual behavior. They mention that he has been under significant stress due to final exams and has become more reclusive. Earlier this evening, he exhibited extreme irritability, yelled at his computer, broke it, and then spent several hours at the gym.

speaker: Doctor
text: The stress of final exams and the recent gym episode suggest high sympathetic tone; have you been consuming significant amounts of caffeine or energy drinks recently, and do you experience palpitations or tremors? REQUEST TEST: Urine_tox_screening.
